input.free_text_description: This system is a microservices platform that serves Admin, User roles. The platform provides capabilities for group, user. Secondary concerns include messaging functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As a Admin, I want to interact with group functionality, so that I can accomplish my group-related tasks.
As a Admin, I want to interact with test functionality, so that I can accomplish my test-related tasks.
As a Admin, I want to use group capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
As a Admin, I want to access the system through a well-defined interface, so that I can perform my tasks efficiently.
